description: Transvaalbuurt 1930 portiek blocks of Albert Luthulistraat 6-32, the stair pand between two towers: a dark red-brown brick front of a 4.1 m ground storey and three 3.1 m upper storeys under a 0.75 m plain parapet with a light coping (top 14.25 m); a window pair at each end (white two-light casements with a top light), and in the middle the portiek: a small window either side of the stair axis, whose stair lights climb half a storey off the main line in an ochre header-brick panel; no tower. Its sibling transvaal-1930-stair-tower is the 14-16.5 m tower pand

match.note: Albert Luthulistraat 6-32 (BAG 1930 on all 7 pands; 3DBAG bouwlagen 5, eaves 12.7-14.8 m, roof max 14.7-14.8 m: the setback roof storey, not the towers, which 3DBAG misses). One design of two pand kinds that BAG cuts alternately: 16.2-16.5 m tower pands (and 073273 at 14.3 m) and 12.6-12.9 m stair pands; the frontage width tells them apart (transvaal-1930-stair-tower 13.8-17.2 m, transvaal-1930-stair-block 12.0-13.6 m).

parapet.note: Albert Luthulistraat 26-28 (088339): coping 14.0-14.3 m over plain brick, the roof-terrace railing of the setback roof storey behind

door-centre.note: the portiek door (red, 1.0 m, head 3.6 m) on the stair axis, a small window and mailboxes either side, no canopy

roof.evidence: Albert Luthulistraat 22-32 strip 2020-04-29: a level coping with a white roof-terrace railing of the setback roof storey behind it (14.4-15.3 m); no roof face over the front; 3DBAG roof max 14.7-14.8 m

rhythm.bays: a window pair, a small window, the stair axis, a small window, a window pair
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: pair + small window + portiek door + small window + pair | 1-3: the same with the stair light
rhythm.groundFloor: the portiek door on the stair axis, no canopy
rhythm.roofline: flat; a plain parapet with a light coping
